FirstPeriodIrregular.1:
Imihango yanje y'intangiriro
ntisanzwe: ni ibisanzwe?
FirstPeriodIrregular.6: Ego, ni ibisanzwe rwose. Dore igituma uruziga rw'imihango rutinda gutekana, n'igihe bikwiye kuvugana n'umuganga.
FirstPeriodIrregular.8: Igituma uruziga rutaba rusanzwe mu ntangiriro
FirstPeriodIrregular.11: Hormone zigenga uruziga rw'imihango zirakenera igihe kugira ngo zibone ukuringaniza kwazo. Ni co gituma bisanzwe ko inzira zihinduka ngufi, ndende canke zitangana mu myaka ya mbere.
FirstPeriodIrregular.12: Uruziga rushobora gufata umwaka umwe kugera ku ibiri, rimwe na rimwe birenzeho, kugira ngo ruce rusanzwe. Iki gihe co guhindura kiratandukanye cane hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi, kitaba ikibazo.
FirstPeriodIrregular.14: Uruziga rutari rusanzwe mu ntangiriro ntirwigera rufatwa nko gutinda: umubiri wawe ufata gusa igihe ukeneye.
FirstPeriodIrregular.15: Mu bihe vyinshi cane, nta co guhagarika umutima. Ariko ni vyiza kubona muganga nimba imihango yawe idaza mu mezi menshi nyuma y'uko itangura, canke nimba ufise amakenga akomeza.
FirstPeriodIrregular.17: Nta mihango mu mezi menshi, ububabare bukomeye cane, canke kuva amaraso menshi cane.
FirstPeriodIrregular.19: Uruziga rusanzwe canke rutari rusanzwe: itandukaniro ni irihe?
FirstPeriodIrregular.21: Imihango yawe ya mbere: ivyo gutegereza
FirstPeriodIrregular.23: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa ku mihango yawe ya mbere
FirstPeriodIrregular.25: Imihango yanje y'intangiriro ntisanzwe: ni ibisanzwe? — AWA

FirstPeriodProtection.1:
Ni ikinga ikihe nokwihitamwo
ku mihango yanje ya mbere?
FirstPeriodProtection.6: Hariho inzira nyinshi zo kwikingira mu gihe c'imihango. Nta n'imwe isumba indi — ukuntu wumva umerewe neza ni co kiyobora ihitamwo.
FirstPeriodProtection.9: Ukuntu wohitamwo ukurikije ukuntu wumva umerewe neza
FirstPeriodProtection.11: Ku mihango yawe ya mbere, pad ni yo isanzwe yoroshe gukoresha, kuko ishirwa muri karuvate yawe. Karuvate zo mu gihe c'imihango na tampon ni izindi nzira ushobora kugerageza nyuma, igihe wumvise ubishaka.
FirstPeriodProtection.13: Biroroshe gukoresha, bishirwa muri karuvate kandi bigahindurwa buri kanya.
FirstPeriodProtection.15: Karuvate zinywa amaraso, zozwa, zoroshe gukoresha buri munsi.
FirstPeriodProtection.17: Zishirwa imbere mu mubiri; kuzikoresha n'igihe co kuzikoresha biri ku wundi, uko ushaka.
FirstPeriodProtection.18: Nta kinga ryiza canke ribi: buri kimwe kigenewe imibiri, imigenzo n'ukuntu abantu bumva bameze neza bitandukanye. Tampon, nk'akarorero, zishirwa imbere mu mubiri kandi zisaba kuwumenyera gatoyi — nta ndwi ivuga ko ugomba kuzikoresha kuva ku mihango yawe ya mbere.
FirstPeriodProtection.20: Kugerageza ubwoko butandukanye bw'ibikinga uko igihe gihita bigufasha kubona ikikubereye cane, nta gukanda.
FirstPeriodProtection.21: Ku rugero, ikinga rikwiye guhindurwa buri masaha 4 kugera kuri 6, kenshi cane mu minsi imihango iri myinshi. Kuhahindura buri kanya bigufasha kuguma wumva umerewe neza no kubungabunga isuku nziza y'ibice vyawe vy'ibanga.
FirstPeriodProtection.25: Ni gute wogenzura imihango yawe ya mbere buri musi?
FirstPeriodProtection.27: Imihango yawe ya mbere: ivyo gutegereza
FirstPeriodProtection.29: Ni ikinga ikihe nokwihitamwo ku mihango yanje ya mbere? — AWA

FirstPeriodSigns.1:
Ibimenyetso vya mbere
vy'imihango yawe ya mbere
FirstPeriodSigns.6: Umubiri wawe kenshi uguha ibimenyetso imihango yawe ya mbere itaraza. Kubimenya birashobora kugufasha kutaganzwa n'igitangaza.
FirstPeriodSigns.11: Mu mezi abanziriza imihango yawe ya mbere, umubiri wawe uhinduka buhorobuhoro: ishusho yawo irahinduka, ubwoya butangura kumera ahantu hashasha, n'ukuntu uvyuya na ho kurahinduka. Ivyo ni ibisanzwe bituruka ku gukura, bitegura umubiri wawe buhorobuhoro.
FirstPeriodSigns.13: Izo mpinduka ntizibaho zose icarimwe, canke ku muvuduko umwe, kuri bose — ni ibisanzwe rwose.
FirstPeriodSigns.15: Umubiri wawe uhinduka buhorobuhoro: ishusho yawo, ubwoya n'ukuntu uvyuya vyose bishobora guhinduka.
FirstPeriodSigns.17: Amazi make yera gato asohoka kenshi mu mezi make imihango yawe ya mbere itaraza.
FirstPeriodSigns.19: Ushobora kumva ububabare buke canke gukwega mu nda yo hasi.
FirstPeriodSigns.21: Ni ibisanzwe kumva woroherwa canke ugacika intege kuruta uko bisanzwe.
FirstPeriodSigns.23: Ushobora kubona amabere abaye yoroshe canke yabyimbye gatoyi.
FirstPeriodSigns.24: Ibi bimenyetso kenshi bivuga ko imihango yawe ya mbere izoza mu mezi akurikira, naho bidashoboka kumenya itarike nyayo. Kugira ikinga hafi bihinduka akamenyero keza muri iki gihe.
FirstPeriodSigns.26: Ibi bimenyetso ni ibiyobora rusangi, ntibigera biba ukuvuga neza igihe. Buri mubiri ukurikiza umuvuduko wawo.
FirstPeriodSigns.28: Imihango yawe ya mbere: ivyo gutegereza
FirstPeriodSigns.30: Nzi gute ko imihango yanje ya mbere iri hafi kuza?
FirstPeriodSigns.34: Ibimenyetso vya mbere imihango yawe ya mbere itaraza — AWA

FlowColorsTextures.6: Ibara n'ubwoko bw'amaraso y'imihango yawe bivuga vyinshi ku buzima bwa hormone zawe. Wige kubisoma kugira ngo usobanukirwe neza uruziga rwawe.
FlowColorsTextures.12: Impanuro zacu zo kugufasha kwimenya neza
FlowColorsTextures.14: Amaraso mashasha, mashya. Bisanzwe mu ntangiriro y'imihango yawe.
FlowColorsTextures.16: Amaraso ya kera, asanzwe hagati mu ruziga.
FlowColorsTextures.18: Amaraso yahinduwe n'umwuka, kenshi mu herezo ry'imihango yawe.
FlowColorsTextures.20: Rishobora kwerekana amaraso make canke impinduka ya hormone.
FlowColorsTextures.30: Arakweguka, atagira ibara canke yera gato.
FlowColorsTextures.34: Uruziga rusanzwe. Umubiri wawe uri gusohora urwego rw'inda.
FlowColorsTextures.36: Amaraso ya kera, nta co guhagarika umutima.
FlowColorsTextures.38: Rishobora kuboneka mu ntangiriro canke mu herezo ry'imihango yawe canke igihe hormone zitaringaniye.
FlowColorsTextures.40: Rikurikirane nimba rigirana n'umunuko ukomeye, kwishima canke ububabare.
FlowColorsTextures.42: Kuva amaraso menshi cane (guhindura ikinga buri saha 1–2)
FlowColorsTextures.43: Gusohora ibibumbe vy'amaraso binini cane buri kanya
FlowColorsTextures.49: Ukurikije amaraso yawe n'ukuntu wumva umerewe neza.
FlowColorsTextures.54: Amaraso y'imihango: gusobanukirwa amabara n'ubwoko — AWA

FlowMenstrual.1:
Kwita ku suku y'ibice vyawe vy'ibanga
mu gihe c'imihango
FlowMenstrual.6: Kwita ku suku y'ibice vyawe vy'ibanga ni ukubaha umubiri wawe n'ukuringaniza kwawo kw'ibanga.
FlowMenstrual.13: Mu gihe c'imihango, umubiri wawe urahinduka ukarushiriza kumva. Kugira imigenzo myiza bifasha kwirinda kurakara n'indwara, no kuguma wumva umerewe neza buri musi.
FlowMenstrual.14: Woza ugwa buhoro: kwoza gusa n'amazi meza, uva imbere werekeza inyuma, birahagije kurinda ibinyabuzima vyawe vy'ibanga.
FlowMenstrual.15: Hindura ikinga buri kanya: buri masaha 4 kugera kuri 6 kugira ngo wirinde ubuhehere n'imyuka mibi.
FlowMenstrual.16: Hitamwo ikoton: karuvate z'ikoton zireka uruhu rwawe rugahumeka kandi zigabanya ingorane yo kurakara.
FlowMenstrual.18: Kwoza imbere mu gitsina n'amazi, bihungabanya ibinyabuzima vyawe vy'ibanga
FlowMenstrual.19: Kugumana pad canke tampon itose igihe kirekire cane
FlowMenstrual.21: Umunuko canke amazi bidasanzwe bitandukanye n'ivyo bisanzwe kuri wewe
FlowMenstrual.22: Ububabare bukomeye canke ibimenyetso bigutera ubwoba
FlowMenstrual.24: Umubiri wawe usanzwe ufise uburyo bw'umuhango bwo kwiringaniza. Koza buhoro biraba bihagije kenshi.
FlowMenstrual.35: Ni gute wokuraho ububabare bw'inda mu buryo bw'umuhango
FlowMenstrual.38: Kwita ku suku y'ibice vyawe vy'ibanga mu gihe c'imihango · AWA

HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.1: Incamake y'imiti ya hormone yo kwirinda gusama
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.6: Ikinini, patch, impeta, implant, IUD ya hormone: ivyo bitandukanya n'ukuntu wokwiyumvira uburyo bubereye ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.12: Uburyo bwa hormone bukoresha hormone kugira ngo birinde gusama. Bitewe n'uburyo, bishobora cane cane kubuza ovulation, gukomeza amazi y'umunwa w'inda, no guhindura ibiri mu nda.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.14: Uburyo bwinshi bushobora gufasha mu kurinda.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.16: Ubundi buryo bubuza canke bukumira isohoka ry'igi.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.18: Amazi ashobora gukomera, bigatuma intanga zigorwa no kunyuramwo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.20: Guhuza ubwo buryo bufasha kugabanya ingorane yo gusama.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.21: Uburyo bwose ntibusaba urwego rumwe rwo kubwitaho. Itandukaniro rikuru ni kangahe ukeneye gutekereza kuri contraception yawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.23: Kuva ku gikorwa cya buri musi kugera ku kurinda kw'igihe kirekire
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.30: Ciza nimba ushaka kwigenga muri contraception yawe
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.34: Biroroshe nimba udashaka akamenyero ka buri musi
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.38: Uburyo bw'ibanga busaba ibikorwa bike bya buri musi
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.42: Bibereye nimba ushaka contraception y'igihe kirekire
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.46: Igisubizo c'igihe kirekire gisaba kwitabwaho gake cane
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.48: Uko uburyo busaba ibikorwa bike bya buri musi, ni ko ukenera gutekereza kuri bwo gake. Ivyo birashobora kwitabwaho nimba uzi ko ushobora kwibagira ikinini canke guhindura.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.49: Nta buryo bumwe bwiza kuri bose. Ihitamwo ryiza riraterwa n'ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi, ivyo ukunda, ukuntu umubiri wawe ubwakira n'imigambi yawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.51: Uburyo bumwe busaba igikorwa cya buri musi, ubundi bugakora ibyumweru bitari bike canke imyaka.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.53: Ukuntu uburyo bwumvikana bushobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi. Kuvugana n'umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima bishobora kugufasha kumenya ikikubereye.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.55: Nimba ushaka gusama vuba canke nyuma, igihe uburyo bumara n'ukuntu bushobora gusubirwamwo bishobora kuyobora ihitamwo ryawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.57: Ibanga, koroha, kutagira akamenyero ka buri musi, canke kurinda igihe kirekire: ivyo ushira imbere ni ngombwa muri iki cemezo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.59: “Nokunda gutekereza kuri contraception yanje buri musi, buri cumweru, canke gusa incuro nkeya mu mwaka?”
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.61: Ikinini canke uburyo busaba kwitabwaho buri kanya
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.63: Patch canke impeta, bitewe n'umuvuduko uhisemwo
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.65: Implant canke IUD ya hormone y'igihe kirekire
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.67: Guhitamwo contraception ya hormone bikwiye kwitwararika ubuzima bwawe bwite n'ubwo kwa muganga. Umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima arashobora kugufasha kugereranya ivyiza, ingorane, ivyo bitagenewe n'ingaruka zishobora kubaho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.70: Uburyo bwa hormone bukoresha hormone zitandukanye n'ingengabihe zitandukanye zo gukoresha.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.71: Ikinini, patch n'impeta bisaba kubyitaho buri kanya, mu gihe implant na IUD ya hormone ari uburyo bw'igihe kirekire.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.72: Ihitamwo rikwiye guhuza n'ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi, ivyo ukunda, ukuntu umubiri wawe wakira n'imigambi yawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.73: Nta buryo na bumwe “bwiza” kuri bose — bukwiye gusa guhuza n'ivyo ukeneye n'ukuntu uri.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.75: Gufata igihe co kugereranya uburyo n'umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima bigufasha guhitamwo contraception ushobora gukoresha utuje kandi buri kanya.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.76: Incamake y'imiti ya hormone yo kwirinda gusama — AWA

HotFlashes.6: Igituma biba, ukuntu wamenya ivyo bibitera, n'ibisubizo bishobora gufasha igihe bigoye.
HotFlashes.14: Hot flashes ziri zisanzwe cane mu gihe co kwerekeza kuri menopause. Zifitaniye isano igice n'impinduka za hormone zigira ingaruka ku buryo ubwonko bugenga ubushyuhe bw'umubiri.
HotFlashes.15: Guhinduka guto kw'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri bishobora noneho kumvikana nk'ubushyuhe butunguranye. Umubiri usubiza mu kwagura imitsi y'amaraso yo mu ruhu, bishobora gutera kumva ubushyuhe, gutukura rimwe na rimwe no kuvyuya cane.
HotFlashes.17: Abagore bamwebamwe bagira ibice bike mu cumweru, abandi bakagira ibice vyinshi mu musi. Ukomera n'igihe bimara na vyo bishobora gutandukana.
HotFlashes.18: Igihe biba mu gihe c'ugusinzira, hot flashes zishobora gutera kuvyuya mu ijoro. Zishobora gutuma ukangura kenshi bigatuma ugusinzira kutaruhura.
HotFlashes.19: Kubura ugusinzira bishobora noneho kongera umunaniro, ingorane yo gutumbera n'uburakari mu musi. Rero birashobora gufasha kwitwararika ubwiza bw'ugusinzira mu gusuzuma ingaruka z'ibimenyetso vyawe.
HotFlashes.21: Impuzu zo kuryamamwo zihumeka, ibitwikirizo vyoroshe n'icumba gikonje bihagije bishobora gufasha kugabanya ukutamererwa neza nijoro.
HotFlashes.22: Ibintu bimwebimwe bishobora gutuma hot flash itangura canke ikaba ikomeye. Ntibitera ibimenyetso kuri bose, ariko kubimenya bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza imigendekere yawe bwite.
HotFlashes.26: Icumba gishyushe cane canke imyambaro iremereye cane
HotFlashes.28: Mu byumweru bitari bike, andika igihe hot flashes zawe ziba, ukuntu zikomeye, n'ivyabaye mbere gato. Ivyo bishobora kugufasha kumenya ivyo bikubera bwite.
HotFlashes.30: Rindira ahantu hawe hakonje kandi hari umwuka mwiza
HotFlashes.31: Humeka buhoro igihe hari hot flash
HotFlashes.33: Ibi bikorwa ntibizoca bituma hot flashes zishira, ariko birashobora koroshya kuzigenzura no kugabanya ukutamererwa neza igihe ziba.
HotFlashes.34: Hot flashes ziri zisanzwe mu gihe cka perimenopause na menopause. Naho ari ukwo, ntiwiye kuzihanganira gusa nimba zikugoye. Umuganga canke umubyaza arashobora gusuzuma ibimenyetso vyawe no kuganira nawe ku buryo butandukanye.
HotFlashes.35: Ni ryari wokwiye gufata igihe co kubona muganga?
HotFlashes.36: Kubona muganga bishobora gufasha cane igihe ibimenyetso bigira ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bwawe bwa buri musi canke igihe ushaka kumenya uburyo buhari.
HotFlashes.38: Hot flashes canke kuvyuya mu ijoro kenshi bigutera gukanguka kenshi, umunaniro ukomeye, canke ingorane yo gukora bisanzwe mu musi.
HotFlashes.39: Igihe ubuzima bwa buri musi bugoye
HotFlashes.40: Nimba hot flashes zibangamira akazi kawe, ibikorwa vyawe, ingendo, umubano n'abandi, canke gusa ukuntu wumva umerewe neza buri musi.
HotFlashes.42: Kwiyongera kugaragara kw'ukuntu ibimenyetso biza kenshi canke bikomeye ni vyiza kubiganiraho kugira ngo habonwe ibisubizo bibereye cane.
HotFlashes.44: Uburyo bwa hormone n'ubudakoresha hormone bushobora gutangwa bitewe n'ukuntu uri. Umuhinga arashobora kugufasha kuringaniza ivyiza vyabwo, ingorane n'ivyo bitagenewe.
HotFlashes.46: Hot flash ishobora kugira ivyayitera bitandukanye. Ibimenyetso bimwebimwe bishobora kandi guhambira n'umuti, ubundi burwaye, canke impinduka ikomeye mu buzima bwawe. Nimba hari ikintu cumvikana bidasanzwe, gishasha, canke gikomeye cane, ni vyiza kuvugana n'umuhinga aho gufata ko ari menopause gusa.
HotFlashes.48: Ububabare mu gituza, guhema nabi gutunguranye, kumva ugiye kuzimirwa, intege nke zitunguranye, canke kubyimba bibabaza bidasanzwe mu kuguru kumwe bisaba ubuvuzi bwihuse.
HotFlashes.49: Ni ibihe bimenyetso bikwiye kwitabwaho cane?
HotFlashes.50: Ububabare bukomeye canke budasanzwe mu gituza
HotFlashes.51: Guhema nabi gutunguranye canke ingorane ikomeye yo guhema
HotFlashes.53: Intege nke zitunguranye, canke ingorane yo kuvuga canke kubona
HotFlashes.54: Kubyimba bibabaza, bidasanzwe mu kuguru kumwe
HotFlashes.56: Nimba hot flashes zigoye bihagije ku buryo zisaba kugenzurwa, uburyo bwinshi bushobora kwitabwaho. Bitewe n'ukuntu uri, umuhinga ashobora kuganira ku bikorwa vy'imibereho, imiti idakoresha hormone, canke, igihe bikwiye, ku muti wa hormone.
HotFlashes.58: Imyaka, ibimenyetso, amateka y'ubuvuzi, imiti ufata ubu n'ivyo ukunda bwite vyose bishobora kugira ingaruka ku buryo butangwa.
HotFlashes.60: Kuza ufise amakuru make bishobora gutuma kubonana na muganga kurushiriza kugira umumaro. Ushobora kwandika, mu minsi canke mu byumweru bitari bike, ukuntu ibice biza kenshi, ukuntu bikomeye, n'ingaruka zabyo ku gusinzira kwawe canke ku bikorwa vyawe.
HotFlashes.64: Ese zikunda kuza mu musi, mu ijoro, canke vyombi?
HotFlashes.65: Ese zihungabanya ugusinzira kwawe canke ibikorwa vyawe?
HotFlashes.67: Ese ubu urafata umuti canke contraception ya hormone?
HotFlashes.68: Ntukeneye gutegereza ko ibimenyetso bikomera cane mbere yo kubivugako. Kubonana na muganga bishobora kandi gufasha gusa gusobanukirwa ivyo biba no kumenya ibisubizo bihari.
HotFlashes.70: Hot flashes ziri zisanzwe mu gihe co kwerekeza kuri menopause.
HotFlashes.71: Kumenya ivyo bitera bishobora kugufasha kugenzura neza ibice.
HotFlashes.72: Imigenzo yoroshe irashobora kugabanya ukutamererwa neza kwa buri musi.
HotFlashes.73: Nimba ibimenyetso bihungabanya ugusinzira canke ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi, vugana n'umuhinga.
HotFlashes.74: Uburyo bwinshi bwo kugenzura bushobora kuganirwaho bitewe n'ukuntu uri.
HotFlashes.75: Hot flashes ziri zisanzwe, ariko ntizikwiye gusuzugurwa igihe zigira ingaruka ku gusinzira kwawe, ku kazi kawe, canke ku buzima bwawe bwiza. Kwitwararika ibimenyetso vyawe no kuvugana n'umuhinga bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza icazitera no gushaka ibisubizo bibereye.
HotFlashes.76: Iyi ngingo ni iyo kumenyesha gusa kandi ntisubira inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye.

HydrationCycle.1:
Kuguma wuzuye amazi
mu ruziga rwawe
HydrationCycle.6: Bisa n'ibidashoboka ariko ni ukuri: kuguma wuzuye amazi neza bifasha umubiri wawe kugumana amazi make mu ruziga rwawe rwose.
HydrationCycle.9: Ivyo ukeneye mu bice vy'uruziga rwawe
HydrationCycle.15: Bisa n'ibidashoboka ariko ni ukuri: kuguma wuzuye amazi neza bifasha umubiri kugumana amazi make no kugabanya kubyimba mu nda, cane cane hafi y'herezo ry'uruziga.
HydrationCycle.17: Igihe umubiri ubuze amazi, ukunda kuyabika kuruta nk'ukwirinda. Kunywa ahagije kuwumenyesha, ahubwo, ko ushobora kurekura amazi koroshe.
HydrationCycle.18: Ivyo ukeneye mu mazi bigumya gutekana muri rusange, ariko hari utuntu duto bitewe n'igice:
HydrationCycle.20: Amazi make yiyongereye afasha kuringaniza amazi yatakaye no kugabanya kubyimba.
HydrationCycle.22: Ivyo ukeneye bigumya gutekana; kwiyongera guke kw'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri bishobora kongera inyota.
HydrationCycle.24: Kunywa amazi neza bifasha kugabanya kumva wabyimbye kenshi kumvikana muri iki gihe.
HydrationCycle.25: Intego ni litiro hafi 1,5 kugera kuri 2 mu musi, nkeya zirenzeho mu gihe c'imihango yawe kugira ngo uringanize amazi yatakaye.
HydrationCycle.27: Litiro hafi 1,5 kugera kuri 2 mu musi, nkeya zirenzeho mu gihe c'imihango yawe.
HydrationCycle.29: Tangawizi canke chamomile bitanga kunywa amazi neza mu gihe cô kuribwa mu nda.
HydrationCycle.31: Kugabanya ibinyobwa birimo isukari nyinshi canke kafeyine bishobora gufasha hafi y'herezo ry'uruziga.
HydrationCycle.37: Imigenzo mike yoroshe kenshi irahagije kugira ngo uguma wuzuye amazi utabitekereje:
HydrationCycle.38: Rindira icupa ry'amazi hafi yawe umusi wose
HydrationCycle.39: Huza igikombe c'amazi n'akamenyero usanzwe ufise (kubyuka, buri funguro)
HydrationCycle.40: Vanga ibinyobwa vy'ibimera nimba amazi yonyine atagukwiye
HydrationCycle.41: Mu gihe c'imyitozo y'umubiri, ibuka kunywa imbere, mu gihe no nyuma y'imyitozo kugira ngo usubize ivyatakaye mu kuvyuya.
HydrationCycle.45: Kunywa amazi neza bifasha umubiri kugumana amazi make.
HydrationCycle.47: Icayi cya tangawizi canke cha chamomile na cyo gitanga kunywa amazi gituje mu gihe cô kuribwa mu nda.
HydrationCycle.48: Kuguma wuzuye amazi neza bifasha umubiri kugumana amazi make no kugabanya kubyimba.
HydrationCycle.49: Intego ni litiro hafi 1,5 kugera kuri 2 mu musi, nkeya zirenzeho mu gihe c'imihango yawe.
HydrationCycle.50: Icayi cya tangawizi canke cha chamomile gishobora kandi gutuza mu gihe cô kuribwa mu nda.
HydrationCycle.51: Inyota ikomeye, idahera ni vyiza kuyibwira umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima.

HydrationCycle.53: Kuguma wuzuye amazi mu ruziga rwawe — AWA

Istihada.6: Gutandukanya kuva amaraso kutari kwo bisanzwe n'imihango yawe isanzwe, hamwe n'ibimenyetso rusangi bigufasha kuyoboka.
Istihada.8: Ibi bikubiyemwo ni vyo kwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy'idini bikwiye kwemezwa n'abahanga bafise ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke ibihano by'idini bihariye.
Istihada.14: Isengesho n'igisibo mu gihe cya Istihâda
Istihada.17: Istihâda bivuga kuva amaraso kuba hanze y'uruziga rw'imihango rusanzwe, canke gukomeza birenze igihe c'imihango cemewe n'umuhango w'Isilamu. Bitandukanye n'imihango (hayd) canke nifas (kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara), ntigire uburyo bumwe bw'idini: kenshi ifatwa nko kuva amaraso kw'ubundi bwoko, rimwe na rimwe guhambira n'icatera mu buvuzi.
Istihada.19: Ibi bikubiyemwo bisobanura igitekerezo mu buryo rusangi; ntibigufasha kumenya nimba kuva amaraso kwihariye guhuye na Istihâda mu buzima bwawe bwite.
Istihada.20: Gutandukanya Istihâda n'imihango canke uruziga rutari rusanzwe bishobora kugorana, kuko kuva amaraso rimwe na rimwe bisa, bigatandukana mu bukomezi, canke bigakomeza mu buryo budasanzwe. Iyi ngorane izwi n'abahanga ubwabo, ico gisobanura igituma hariho uburyo bwinshi bwo kuyimenya.
Istihada.22: Ni ibisanzwe kutamenya ako kanya ico kuva amaraso kudasanzwe kuvuga; uku kutamenya ni uko bimeze kenshi, si ikosa ryawe.
Istihada.23: Ibintu bimwebimwe bishobora kuyobora ivyo ugira, bitari amategeko ku bose, kuko ibimenyetso nyabyo bitandukana bitewe n'amashure y'amategeko y'idini.
Istihada.27: Ukuntu kuva amaraso gusanzwe canke kudasanzwe
Istihada.29: Ukuntu kuva amaraso guhinduka uko igihe gihita
Istihada.33: Ibi bintu ni ibimenyetso rusangi, ntibiri amategeko yuzuye: bishobora gusobanurwa mu buryo butandukanye n'abahanga n'amashure y'amategeko y'idini.
Istihada.34: Gufata igihe co kurikirana kuva amaraso kwawe mu minsi myinshi, utihuta, bigufasha gusobanukirwa neza ukuntu uri imbere yo gufata umwanzuro.
Istihada.36: Andika itarike yatangiriyeho kandi, nimba bishoboka, uko uruziga rwawe rumara bisanzwe
Istihada.37: Reba nimba kuva amaraso gukurikiza ishusho ihuye n'imihango yawe ya kera
Istihada.38: Ntuhambire ku musi umwe gusa wihariye
Istihada.39: Andika ivyo wabonye nimba uteganya kubonana n'umuhanga canke umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima
Istihada.40: Mu gihe cya Istihâda, isengesho n'igisibo kenshi bikomeza kuba itegeko, bitandukanye n'igihe c'imihango. Ingamba z'isuku (nk'ikinga rikwiye) zirasabwa kugira ngo ugusenga gukomeze, hakurikijwe uburyo bwigishwa n'amashure atandukanye y'amategeko y'idini.
Istihada.42: Ingamba nyazo (nko gusubiramwo wudu) zishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ishure ry'amategeko y'idini ukurikiza; kwiyambaza igitekerezo ukurikiza bisanzwe canke umuhanga afise ubushobozi bigufasha kuzikoresha neza.
Istihada.43: Amakenga adahera ku kamere k'ukuva amaraso ni ibisanzwe, kandi ntikwiye kuba isoko yo guhangayika birenze urugero.
Istihada.44: Raba igihe n'ingenzi isanzwe y'imihango yawe bwite
Istihada.45: Raba umuhinga mu vy'ubuzima nimba kuva amaraso kudasanzwe canke kumara igihe kirekire
Istihada.46: Baza umuhanga afise ubushobozi igitekerezo ciwe ku ruhande rw'idini
Istihada.47: Ibuka ko igisubizo rusangi gisubira ntigisubira ubuyobozi bubereye ukuntu uri
Istihada.49: Ibi bikubiyemwo bigumya kuba vyo kwigisha kandi rusangi: ntibiri fatwa canke igihano cy'idini cyihariye. Ku kibazo cose bwite, cane cane igihe hari amakenga amara igihe, igitekerezo c'umuhanga afise ubushobozi gikomeza kuba ishingiro.
Istihada.51: Istihâda ni igitekerezo gitandukanya kuva amaraso kudasanzwe n'imihango canke nifas, gifise ingaruka zihariye ku isengesho n'igisibo. Igihe hari amakenga, kurikirana neza n'igitekerezo c'umuhanga afise ubushobozi bikomeza kuba ibikoresho vyiza.
